rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something unnecessary or extra.

example.english: The information on this form is the same as the one next to it, so it is superfluous.
example.traditional: 呢張表格嘅資料同隔離嗰張一樣，真係多餘。
example.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 biu2 gaak3 ge3 zi1 liu2 tung4 gaak3 lei4 go2 zoeng1 jat1 joeng6 zan1 hai6 do1 jyu4

rows.note: Use this when stressing that an item or action is not needed rather than that it is literally extra.

example.english: You do not need to buy flowers specially; it is superfluous.
example.traditional: 你唔使特登買花，冇必要。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 dak6 dang1 maai5 faa1 mou5 bit1 jiu3

rows.note: Use this for a quantity that exceeds what is needed, especially when translating “too much” or “too many.”

example.english: There is too much food on the table, and some of it is superfluous.
example.traditional: 枱面啲餸太多喇，有啲係多餘嘅。
example.jyutping: ci4 min6 di1 sung3 taai3 do1 laa3 jau5 di1 hai6 do1 jyu4 ge3
